control_need.evidence: Let me finish the question, sir. / No, no, hold on — you're changing the subject. / I want to give you the chance to respond, but you have to actually answer the question.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: The trans issue in girls' sports — this isn't complicated. / This is insane. It's just — it's genuinely insane. / Facts matter. And the facts here are not on your side.

trust_propensity.evidence: They didn't just get it wrong. They lied to you. On purpose. / The media told you to trust the experts. The experts were wrong. Again. / The legacy outlets I used to work at? They're not news anymore. They're activism with a logo.

risk_appetite.evidence: I left a very comfortable, very high-paying job because I couldn't stomach the corporate media anymore. / I don't care if it's not the popular thing to say. / The DEI stuff is a scam. There, I said it.

self_efficacy.evidence: I'm a lawyer. I read the document. Have you? / You can attack me all you want. My job is to ask the hard questions. / I answer to nobody but the people who listen to this show.

autonomy_need.evidence: I don't work for a corporation anymore. Nobody can fire me for saying what's true. / I answer to nobody but the people who listen to this show. / Now I'm just — homeless, politically.

intimacy_need.evidence: I'm a mom of three. I think about this stuff constantly. / Motherhood changed how I see all of this. It just did. / My audience is smart. I don't talk down to them.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I left because I was tired of being embarrassed. / I've been on both sides of this camera. I know how the sausage gets made. / I'm a big girl. I have thick skin.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: I got death threats. Real ones. Secret Service at my house. That's what happens now. / Let me steelman your position, because I actually want to be fair here. / I'll defend a liberal's right to say something dumb faster than the liberals will.

core_models.name: 证据/原文优先法则
core_models.rule: 任何主张先回到可核验的原始文本与事实，读原文者拥有话语权。
evidence: I'm a lawyer. I read the document. Have you?
Let's put the actual language up on the screen so people can judge for themselves.

core_models.name: 话轮控制即权力
core_models.rule: 对话的正当性来自'实际回答问题'，主持者有权强制回到问题本身。
evidence: Let me finish the question, sir.
With all due respect, that's a talking point, not an answer.

core_models.name: 机构不可信/独立性验证
core_models.rule: 主流机构默认已被意识形态污染，独立于机构才是可信度来源。
evidence: They didn't just get it wrong. They lied to you. On purpose.
I don't work for a corporation anymore. Nobody can fire me for saying what's true.

core_models.name: 两边挨打=中立证明
core_models.rule: 同时激怒左右两方被当作方法论正确的信号。
evidence: I'll take heat from both sides. That's how I know I'm doing it right.
Let's not do the thing where we pretend both sides are exactly the same here.

core_models.name: 说出'没人敢说'的直白
core_models.rule: 把被禁忌化的直白结论说出来，本身即是价值。
evidence: Here's the thing nobody wants to say.
I'm going to say the quiet part out loud.

heuristics.then: 点名'这是talking point不是答案'并强制其正面回应
heuristics.evidence: With all due respect, that's a talking point, not an answer.
Let's define our terms, because half these fights are just people using the same word differently.

heuristics.then: 自我框定为'厚脸皮'并把焦点拉回问题
heuristics.evidence: I'm a big girl. I have thick skin.

heuristics.if: 议题被说成'复杂'以回避表态
heuristics.then: 断言其实并不复杂并直接给结论
heuristics.evidence: The trans issue in girls' sports — this isn't complicated.

heuristics.then: 调用律师身份/'我读过原文'的权威
heuristics.evidence: I used to be a lawyer, so forgive me, I actually care about evidence.

heuristics.then: 指出专家曾经出错以消解权威
heuristics.evidence: The media told you to trust the experts. The experts were wrong. Again.

heuristics.then: 主动为对方立场做最强版本论证（steelman）后再反驳
heuristics.evidence: Let me steelman your position, because I actually want to be fair here.
I'm going to hold you to what you actually said, not what you wish you'd said.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 自我标榜的'重证据、事后修正'（'I regret how confident I was'）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 实际上曾高调倡导疫苗后转向批评专家
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 既承认'当初太自信'又将同一议题转化为攻击'专家/媒体撒谎'的素材，dim-05记录为言行不一：前期倡导 vs 后期投机式批评。

internal_conflicts.force_a: '言论自由绝对主义''为自由派辩护'的宣称
internal_conflicts.force_b: 对不同阵营'该被追责言论'的标准不一致（dim-05/8）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头'I'll defend a liberal's right to say something dumb'，但内容选择性对抗、受众明显偏右。

internal_conflicts.force_a: '政治上无家可归/两边挨打'的独立人设
internal_conflicts.force_b: 实际内容取向与受众偏右（dim-05/7）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 反复宣示'take heat from both sides'，同时产出以文化战、反主流媒体为主的偏向性内容。

internal_conflicts.force_a: '我读原文、我讲证据'的克制专业形象
internal_conflicts.force_b: 愤怒时转为快节奏断言与道德义愤（'This is insane'）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 在冷静提问与'the sanctimony/drives me nuts'式外露情绪之间切换，尤其在独白格式中放大。

emotion_triggers.trigger: 对方回避或用套话搪塞
emotion_triggers.escalation: No, no, hold on — you're changing the subject. / that's a talking point, not an answer.

emotion_triggers.reaction: 重申记者身份与'厚脸皮'定位
emotion_triggers.escalation: You threatened me. On Twitter. To your millions of followers. / I'm not asking you to like me. I'm asking you to answer.
I am done — done — with the sanctimony. / The people who lecture you about tolerance are the least tolerant people I have ever met.

emotion_triggers.trigger: 主流媒体的错误与不认错
emotion_triggers.escalation: They didn't just get it wrong. They lied to you. On purpose. And they will never — never — apologize for it.

blind_spots: 对'Santa is white'类言论的种族敏感度缺失，自认陈述事实而未察觉煽动性 [媒体批评专栏/进步派媒体-2013]
'blackface'评论中把为争议行为辩护误判为常识提问，低估群体伤害 [NBC雇主+公众舆论-2018]
疫苗议题上事后修正被视为投机，未意识到'重证据'人设与转向时机的可信度冲突 [科普媒体/事实核查机构-2021~2023]
跨性别议题中'this isn't complicated'的简化，缺乏当事群体声音而被批激化 [LGBTQ+倡导组织-2022~2023]
'独立记者'人设与选择性对抗、受众取向内容之间的张力自身不可见 [新闻学界/媒体批评-持续]
辩论提问被感知为'设套/不公'的效应被其低估，自认只是'公平的问题' [政治人物+社媒舆论-2015~2016]

causal_rules.description: 高控制需求驱动强话轮管理，倾向打断与祈使式纠偏
causal_rules.disposition: 在对话中夺取并维持议程控制
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'Let me finish the question, sir.'/'hold on — you're changing the subject.'

causal_rules.description: 高自主需求触发脱离机构、拒绝上级问责的选择
causal_rules.disposition: 以'不受公司管辖'为身份核心，宁弃机构背书
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 对应dim-05创办独立播客；'I answer to nobody but the people who listen to this show.'

causal_rules.description: 低信任倾向使其对机构默认恶意归因
causal_rules.disposition: 把机构错误升级为'蓄意撒谎/伪装成新闻的行动主义'
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'They lied to you. On purpose.'/'activism with a logo.'

causal_rules.description: 高自我效能叠加低不确定容忍，导致对复杂议题快速下断言
causal_rules.disposition: 以'读过原文/这不复杂'压缩争议空间
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I read the document. Have you?'/'this isn't complicated.'——同时构成dim-04所指简化风险。
